newsitem.title: USA: US spot jet bolts higher on NYMEX, but diffs ease.
newsitem.headline: US spot jet bolts higher on NYMEX, but diffs ease.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices soared over two cents a gallon on Monday, traders said, slightly offset by weaker differentials in both New York Harbor and the Gulf Coast.
NYMEX February heating oil prices jumped 2.35 cents a gallon amid a 10-day forecast of below-normal temperatures in the East Coast.

But diffs eased 0.20 cent in both centers. "There are no buyers. I'm trying to sell and can't find a bite," one New York trader said. Gulf traders said continuing allocations on the Colonial pipeline were backing up supplies there.
